items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When Benny Golson and I organized the Jazztet, I got him in the group.

ctx.x: Which years was he in school?

He was in school for four years. I would say ’49 or ’50 for four years. When Benny Golson and I organized the Jazztet, I got him in the group. He was in the group with the Jazztet, but he wasn’t really into what the guys out here were in to.
While he was attending Juilliard, he wasn’t maintaining jazz gigs?
